methodology.execution: One coordinator; platform windows are sequential and rotated. Encrypt/estimate/sign all window requests before broadcasting. At most C independent writer transactions in a receipt-synchronized wave. Actual broadcast spreads retained.
methodology.order: Canonical (blockNumber,transactionIndex), checked against contract sequence; submission and decryption completion order are not state order.
methodology.snapshots: Unique request IDs persist each intermediate output; reading shared latest state is never used as a per-request result.
methodology.concurrencyAudit: Decrypt snapshots and final state after all window receipts, serially with the operator. Audit-call durations are already-ready retrieval, not primary completion latency or network capacity. Receipt throughput excludes preparation/audit.
methodology.circuits: Fresh inputs loaded and every input decrypted/validated before one measured compute transaction. Linear/tree reductions have equal add counts; affine chains increase both operations and depth.
methodology.capacity: Known exact Zama HCU-limit rejections at estimateGas are recorded without reserving a compute nonce, receipt, gas or completion latency. Continue the remaining planned cases; executionComplete does not imply every trial is valid. Unexpected errors stop execution.
methodology.setup: Deployment, authorization, fresh window zero-state/input loading and readiness recorded separately, including gas. One warmup per case; C=1 concurrency uses forward/reverse controls on identical inputs.
methodology.failure: No automatic retransmission of any on-chain mutation; save prepared hashes before release. Stop after any failed/inconsistent trial; drain a released wave. Reverts and unavailable plaintext are incomplete trials, not proven state inconsistencies.
methodology.observation: Client/RPC/service latency on a public network, not isolated FHE compute. Larger server hints respected. All read waits counted. No live platform comparison is assumed causal.
methodology.local: Local mode uses unlocked Hardhat sends for correctness tests; its timing and signing path are not Sepolia performance evidence.
methodology.continuation: Original trials and setup prefixes retained exactly. Continue only never-submitted preparations and unattempted slots. Reuse confirmed circuit loads or a zero-window setup; skip completed controls/warmups and existing deployments. A partial prepared batch is recreated only after exact nonce and unused-request checks. Duration scope and discarded unused hashes are recorded.
